Welcome to Cadence
Track your period and see when the next one is likely to start.
Private by design
Everything stays on this phone, encrypted. Cadence has no internet access, no account and no ads.
Cadence gives estimates, not medical advice, and can\'t be used as contraception.
Get started
When did your last period start?
Pick the first day of bleeding. An estimate is fine.
I don\'t remember
How long is your cycle, usually?
Count from the first day of one period to the first day of the next. Most cycles are 24 to 38 days.
cycle length
How many days does your period usually last?
Most periods last 2 to 8 days.

Do you use hormonal birth control?
